## Skills covered

-   Planning and managing Azure AI solutions with **Azure AI Foundry** — model selection across LLMs, SLMs, and multimodal models; infrastructure design, CI/CD integration, quota management, and cost footprint control
-   Building **generative AI** applications — deploying and consuming models, implementing **retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)** with semantic, hybrid, and vector search, and evaluating outputs for relevance, quality, and safety
-   Designing and deploying **agents** — function-calling, conversation memory, tool integration (APIs, knowledge stores, search), autonomous workflows with approval controls, and **multi-agent orchestration**
-   **Computer vision** and multimodal workflows — image and video generation, visual Q&A, alt-text generation, and Content Understanding pipelines for object and region identification
-   **Text analysis** and **speech** — entity extraction, sentiment, summarisation, translation, and speech-to-text/text-to-speech for agentic modalities
-   **Information extraction** — OCR, layout analysis, and field extraction using Content Understanding to produce grounded structured outputs for RAG and agent tools
-   Applying **responsible AI** across the full solution — safety filters, guardrails, risk detection, trace logging, provenance metadata, and agent oversight controls
